description: This PHP file defines the ImportMapGoogle class, which extends ImportMapOther to provide specific data mapping configuration for importing contact data from Google sources into the CRM system. It contains a method getMapping that returns default field mappings tailored for Google data, including contact names, addresses, phones, emails, and team/assignment info.

classes.name: ImportMapGoogle
classes.description: Class extending ImportMapOther that provides Google-specific import mappings for CRM contacts.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns default mapping array for a specified module, with special mappings for Google contact data.
